title: StrategyBuilder dual-MA template
summary: Natural language to StrategySpec is Plan-only and currently dual-MA cross.
narrative:
StrategyBuilder is a closed Job: NL → spec → codegen → sanity → Operator, optionally backtest. This stage supports RuleIterator dual-MA golden/death cross with explicit fast/slow windows (for example 20/60).

Ask does not write strategy files. Follow-up sentences in a session can change slots such as slow without starting a new Job.
python_code:
from qteasy_ai.app import QteasyAssistant
assistant = QteasyAssistant()
plan = assistant.plan('帮我写一个基于 20/60 日均线金叉死叉的择时策略', response_style='raw')
print([s['skill_name'] for s in plan['plan']['steps']])
risk_notes: PT+VS in one sentence clarifies. Generated code lands under .qteasy/ai/strategies/.
